blind.table_distance_name: coffin with funeral pall on a bier
blind.description: A wooden funeral bier/catafalque supporting a coffin draped in a rich crimson or burgundy velvet funeral pall cloth. The cloth has folded/draped fabric skirts with gold trim along the borders and a central golden heraldic crest/emblem depicted on top. Beneath the draped cloth, a sturdy wooden stand or table with turned/carved legs and stretchers supports the structure on four block feet resting flat on the ground. Surfaces are fully solid, continuous, hand-painted stylized textures with clean geometry and no unattached or broken parts.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated hexagonal coffin shape draped in deep red cloth with a gold border outline and a golden beetle/heraldic insignia in the center, with the pleated drape folds and wooden feet projecting slightly from beneath along the edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly waist-high or slightly below half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 6 feet long and 2.5 feet wide.
